title: Copy, confirmed
description: A copy icon draws into a check, while its label quietly confirms the action.
useCase: Confirm that a share link, token or command has actually reached the clipboard.
reducedMotion: The checkmark and status appear immediately, with no scaling, travel or blur.
limitations: Clipboard permissions can be denied; the component reports failure and keeps the example link visible.
look: Cool light-grey page with a grey monospace URL above a single white rounded button holding a small line icon and label.
motion: Clicking fades and shrinks the copy icon as a checkmark draws in 0.26 s; labels crossfade on springs with a 3 px blur and offset, reverting after 2 s.
adapt: `useCopyToClipboard` (with `writeFallback`) owns status and the 2000 ms `timeout`; the checkmark animates `pathLength` with `DRAW`, icons and `labels` crossfade with `CROSSFADE`. Replace the example URL and `labels`; keep the error state and live announcement.
